incidents.resolution: Added idempotency keys and refunded customers
incidents.symptoms: Some customers were charged twice for a deposit
incidents.title: Duplicate deposit charges due to a retry bug

incidents.resolution: Paused the migration and rewrote it as a batched backfill
incidents.root_cause: Migration added a column and backfilled it while holding a long lock
incidents.symptoms: Balance reads slow; lock waits on ledger-db during a schema migration backfill
incidents.title: Ledger migration locked a table during backfill

incidents.root_cause: Load balancer idle timeout shorter than the gateway keep-alive timeout
incidents.symptoms: Sporadic 502s for a small share of users; upstream reset before headers
incidents.title: Sporadic 502s from a load balancer idle-timeout mismatch

incidents.root_cause: Rules engine upgrade failed to load a rule set
incidents.symptoms: Orders rejected because risk checks failed; risk-service error rate spiked after a deploy
incidents.title: risk-service 503s after a rules engine upgrade

incidents.resolution: Fixed the NTP configuration and added clock-offset alerts
incidents.root_cause: chrony misconfiguration on one node pool
incidents.symptoms: Log timestamps from some gateway nodes were minutes off, making errors appear before their cause
incidents.title: Clock skew on gateway nodes confused log timelines

incidents.resolution: Reverted the CoreDNS change and added config validation
incidents.root_cause: Bad forwarder address in the CoreDNS config pushed to one zone
incidents.symptoms: Intermittent upstream connect errors from the gateway in one availability zone; SERVFAIL answers
incidents.title: DNS resolver misconfiguration broke service discovery in one zone

incidents.resolution: Renewed the certificate and added expiry alerting
incidents.root_cause: Public certificate expired because the auto-renewal job was failing
incidents.symptoms: Browsers reported certificate errors; mobile login failed
incidents.title: Expired public TLS certificate on the edge load balancer

incidents.resolution: Rolled back and bounded the cache
incidents.root_cause: Unbounded in-memory cache introduced in a release
incidents.symptoms: Periodic out-of-memory restarts every few hours; memory sawtooth
incidents.title: Memory leak in portfolio-service after a caching change

incidents.resolution: Rolled back the deployment and added a unit test
incidents.root_cause: Regression in order validation code shipped in a deployment
incidents.symptoms: Spike of HTTP 500 on order placement minutes after a deploy; NullPointerException in a validator
incidents.title: orders-service 500s after release: null pointer in order validation

incidents.resolution: Ramped the flag down and batched the queries
incidents.root_cause: New code path behind a feature flag issued one query per position
incidents.symptoms: Database CPU saturated right after a feature flag was ramped up; queries per request jumped
incidents.title: Feature flag rollout caused N+1 queries on portfolio-db

incidents.resolution: Enabled queued deposits and escalated to the vendor
incidents.root_cause: Incident on the third-party bank gateway (vendor side)
incidents.symptoms: payments-service errors and timeouts calling bank-gateway; provider latency rose sharply
incidents.title: Deposits timing out: bank-gateway latency degradation

incidents.resolution: Scaled out portfolio-service and tuned the pool size
incidents.root_cause: Traffic spike exceeded the connection pool capacity
incidents.symptoms: Portfolio page timeouts; connection pool wait time high; request rate high during a market rally
incidents.title: portfolio-service connection pool exhaustion during a traffic spike

incidents.root_cause: Node pool upgrade evicted pods without connection draining
incidents.symptoms: Sporadic connection resets on order calls during cluster maintenance
incidents.title: orders-service pod evictions during a node upgrade

incidents.root_cause: notification-service deploy introduced a slow template renderer
incidents.symptoms: Trade confirmation emails delayed; consumer lag growing on notification-service
incidents.title: Notification delays due to a slow consumer after a deploy

incidents.resolution: Increased cache memory and tuned TTLs
incidents.root_cause: app-cache hit its memory limit and mass evictions pushed load to the databases
incidents.symptoms: Portfolio and orders reads slow with p99 of 4-6 seconds; cache hit ratio dropped; database load increased
incidents.title: Redis eviction storm slowed portfolio reads

incidents.resolution: Raised the autoscaler maximum and added retry budgets with jitter
incidents.root_cause: Traffic surge beyond capacity amplified by client retries
incidents.symptoms: Quotes slow and erroring at market open; CPU at max; autoscaler at max replicas; client retries
incidents.title: Market-open traffic surge saturated quotes-service
